items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: I remember recording at Rudy Van Gelder’s, a CTI recording with Esther Phillips

ctx.x: Recording yourself, you know at my studio I have a rudimentary set up I mean a mic on the bass drum and an overhead mic. So it’s kind of like the way they recorded in the 30s or the 40s, you know one mic or maybe two mics. And record that, playing at different volumes and different feels and listen back and adjust accordingly. When I first got to New York in the 70s there was a lot, there was so much work around and a lot of it was demos, you know making demos for people. And it wasn’t in the A studios, it was in…
You never forgot that, wow. And it’s interesting that he didn’t come out and tell you what you were doing, he just decided I’m going to fix this, I’m not going to screw around.
